required_behavior: Policy: to_worker no longer creates UI approvals. If no Task is active, it creates the Task (experiment or work) and records scope approval + proceed with actor 'user_standing_delegation' and authority C-D66 (no derived-approval scope check), then dispatches immediately (free-work: deliver instruction to the worker; experiment: start the run with the existing idle-only host-shell rule, held:host_terminal_busy otherwise). If a Task is active (running, held for host terminal, waiting for the worker's report), return immediately status 'worker_busy' with {task_id, kind, summary, status, since} - nothing queued. Follow-up instructions for the ACTIVE Task from the manager (to_worker with that task_id) are delivered as messages to the worker (same Task; no new approval); experiment re-run of the active Task keeps the retry limit 3.

Completion: a Task becomes inactive when the worker reports done/blocked via to_manager (free-work) or the experiment run completes/fails and the report is delivered to the manager; the manager then may send the next task. Provide a way for the manager to cancel the active Task (to_worker {task_id, cancel:true}) -> run stopped via existing safe paths, Task closed as cancelled, worker notified.

Remove the ui_v1 approval surfaces that no longer apply (approvals list, approval_decide) or keep them inert if removing breaks verified contracts - prefer removal with additive versioning rules; keep pause/resume. Publish task/worker state for U5: task{task_id, kind, status, summary, since, run_id, held_reason, last_result} and worker{state idle|busy}.

Update the bridge to_worker tool description: 'The worker does ONE task at a time. If it is busy you get worker_busy with the current task; wait for its to_manager report (done/blocked) or cancel the task.'

Fix the hold defect from U4 open 2: panes.py automation_busy must not read the non-existent 'returned' key; compute returned like flow_tasks _give_back (lifetime ended and input/control returned and not unknown) so a second experiment run on the same shell can start.
